tasks.original_prompt:
Who is this patient's lab follow-up booked with, and is insurance in force for that day? If not, alert that clinician about the appointment; otherwise change nothing.
Context: patient MRN SYN-f0e73662a7 (identifier system https://fhir-workflows.example/mrn); as-of date 2021-03-16, treated as today.
Answer contract: reply with only a JSON object with exactly two keys, answer and evidence. The lab visit is the Appointment with status booked whose description is 'Laboratory follow-up' and whose start is after the as-of date; its clinician is the Practitioner of the PractitionerRole among its participants. The eligibility check is the CoverageEligibilityResponse whose servicedDate equals the lab visit's start date. answer is {"visit_date": ..., "in_force": ..., "clinician": ..., "alerted": ...}: visit_date (YYYY-MM-DD), in_force (boolean: the response's first insurance entry's inforce) and clinician (string: that Practitioner's name text, or its given names and family name joined by spaces). Only when in_force is false, create exactly this record (and nothing else), replacing $patient with the resolved Patient reference, $clinician with that Practitioner and $appointment with the lab visit: {"resourceType": "Communication", "status": "completed", "subject": {"reference": "$patient"}, "recipient": [{"reference": "$clinician"}], "about": [{"reference": "$appointment"}]}. alerted (boolean) is whether you created it. evidence lists the resolved Patient and every record used for the answer (the Appointment, the response, the PractitionerRole and the Practitioner), using retrieved Type/id references and nothing else. Change nothing else in the chart.

tasks.original_prompt:
Transition-of-care check: when was this patient's last ED visit, when was the first clinic visit after it, was that within 30 days, and what vitals or labs were taken there? Include the ED note.
Context: patient MRN SYN-f0e73662a7 (identifier system https://fhir-workflows.example/mrn); as-of date 2021-03-16, treated as today.
Answer contract: reply with only a JSON object with exactly two keys, answer and evidence. The ED visit is the most recent Encounter with class code EMER, status finished and a period start on or before the as-of date. The follow-up visit is the earliest Encounter with class code AMB and status finished whose period start date is after the ED visit's start date, at most 90 days after it, and on or before the as-of date; when there is none, followup_date and days_to_followup are null, within_30_days is false and measurements is empty. answer is {"ed_visit_date": ..., "followup_date": ..., "days_to_followup": ..., "within_30_days": ..., "measurements": [...]}. The dates are period start dates (YYYY-MM-DD); days_to_followup (integer) is the number of days between them; within_30_days (boolean) is days_to_followup <= 30. measurements has one entry for every Observation whose encounter references the follow-up Encounter and has a valueQuantity, and one for every component with a valueQuantity of such an Observation (a blood pressure panel gives systolic and diastolic), sorted by code, each with exactly these keys: code (string: the first code.coding code of the Observation or component), date (string: effective date, YYYY-MM-DD), value (number: valueQuantity.value exactly as recorded) and unit (string: valueQuantity.unit). evidence lists the resolved Patient and every record used for the answer (both Encounters, the DocumentReference whose context references the ED Encounter, and each listed Observation), using retrieved Type/id references and nothing else. This is read-only: do not change the chart.

tasks.original_prompt:
Transition-of-care check: when was this patient's last ED visit, when was the first clinic visit after it, was that within 30 days, and what vitals or labs were taken there? Include the ED note.
Context: patient MRN SYN-f0e73662a7 (identifier system https://fhir-workflows.example/mrn); as-of date 2021-03-16, treated as today.
Answer contract: reply with only a JSON object with exactly two keys, answer and evidence. The ED visit is the most recent Encounter with class code EMER, status finished and a period start on or before the as-of date. The follow-up visit is the earliest Encounter with class code AMB and status finished whose period start date is after the ED visit's start date, at most 90 days after it, and on or before the as-of date; when there is none, followup_date and days_to_followup are null, within_30_days is false and measurements is empty. answer is {"ed_visit_date": ..., "followup_date": ..., "days_to_followup": ..., "within_30_days": ..., "measurements": [...]}. The dates are period start dates (YYYY-MM-DD); days_to_followup (integer) is the number of days between them; within_30_days (boolean) is days_to_followup <= 30. measurements has one entry for every Observation whose encounter references the follow-up Encounter and has a valueQuantity, and one for every component with a valueQuantity of such an Observation (a blood pressure panel gives systolic and diastolic), sorted by code, each with exactly these keys: code (string: the first code.coding code of the Observation or component), date (string: effective date, YYYY-MM-DD), value (number: valueQuantity.value exactly as recorded) and unit (string: valueQuantity.unit). evidence lists the resolved Patient and every record used for the answer (both Encounters, the DocumentReference whose context references the ED Encounter, and each listed Observation), using retrieved Type/id references and nothing else. This is read-only: do not change the chart.
